overloadPatches.semanticRole: Removes the Picture Library graphic identified by picRef; does nothing if no picture has that reference number.
Removes the Picture Library graphic identified by picName; does nothing if no picture has that name.

constraints: Cannot be used in projects; the Picture Library only exists in binary (.4DB) databases.
Has no effect when called from a method executed on the 4D Server machine (stored procedure or trigger); the call is silently ignored there.
